# Md Rakibujjaman Adib (ADIB X ME)
> Creative Developer & AI Architect | Erasmus+ Scholar (Windesheim UAS) | Full-Stack & 3D Specialist

## Summary
Md Rakibujjaman Adib is an international creative technologist, full-stack web developer, AI systems architect, and 3D visual artist based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, with extensive academic and professional experience in the Netherlands and the United Kingdom. He is an Erasmus+ European Union Scholar at Windesheim University of Applied Sciences (Zwolle, Netherlands), Founder of MCT Labs, and Co-Founder of Green D (an IoT power-metering and AI carbon telemetry platform).

He builds high-performance digital products, responsive web architectures, autonomous AI pipelines, interactive 3D visualizations, and serious games for clients across Bangladesh, the Netherlands, the UK, Europe, and globally.

## Core Capabilities & Services
1. **Full-Stack Web Development**: High-performance static and dynamic web applications built with React, TypeScript, Next.js, Vite, and Tailwind CSS. Responsive bento layouts, micro-interactions, Core Web Vitals optimization, and static build prerendering.
2. **Graphic Design & Brand Architecture**: Complete visual brand identity systems, typography systems, vector iconography, marketing collateral, restaurant menu design (UK/EU market), and digital design systems.
3. **AI Architecture & Workflow Automation**: Edge sensing telemetry, computer vision / receipt OCR pipelines, autonomous LLM agent systems, multimodal data ingestion, and predictive emission modeling.
4. **3D CGI, Visualization & Motion Design**: Photorealistic product rendering, architectural visualization, lighting projection & volumetric fog simulation (V-Ray, 3ds Max), motion design, and video production.
5. **Game Development & Simulation**: Serious game engineering using Unity and C# with the 038GAMES studio at Windesheim UAS.
